北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 31℃，注意防晒，多补充水分哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels like 31℃. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阴天，体感 31℃。风力 4级，出门带伞，注意防潮。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with 4-level winds. Bring an umbrella, mind the dampness.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 34℃ 炎热，请注意防暑降温，避免中暑！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like a hot 34℃. Stay cool to avoid heatstroke!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 34℃ 潮湿，多喝水，防晒防暑很重要。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and feels like a humid 34℃. Drink water, protect from sun and heat.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 82%。记得多喝水，小心潮湿哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 30℃ with 82% humidity. Drink water and watch out for dampness!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力 5级，多云，体感舒适。出门注意防风，小心着凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has 5-level winds, cloudy and comfortable. Be mindful of wind, avoid catching a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 31℃，风力 4级。湿度高，注意防潮。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with 4-level winds and high humidity. Mind the dampness.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 96%！潮湿感明显，注意防霉防潮。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with 96% humidity! It feels very damp, protect against mold and moisture.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 36℃ 酷热！务必多喝水，避暑降温。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like a scorching 36℃! Drink plenty of water and stay cool.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 31℃，注意防晒，多补充水分。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 31℃. Remember sunscreen and hydrate well.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 67%。外出请带伞，预防阵雨。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 30℃ with 67% humidity. Take an umbrella for possible showers.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 32℃。天气炎热，请多饮水，注意防晒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feels like 32℃. It's hot, drink more water and protect from sun.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 33℃。阳光强烈，防晒和补水是关键！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 33℃. Strong sun, sunscreen and hydration are key!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 23℃ 舒适。温差大，早晚注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like a comfortable 23℃. Mind the temperature changes, dress in layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 31℃，湿度 86%。出行带伞，保持凉爽。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 31℃ with 86% humidity. Carry an umbrella and stay cool.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，风力 5级。体感 25℃，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 5-level winds. Feels like 25℃, stay warm and guard against wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连小雨，体感 27℃。出门记得带雨具，注意路滑哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has light rain, feels like 27℃. Take rain gear and be careful of slippery roads.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，体感 33℃ 潮热。记得多喝水，小心中暑哦！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy, feels like a humid 33℃. Drink water and watch out for heatstroke!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多阴，体感 32℃，湿度高，出门记得带伞，保持干爽。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 32℃ with high humidity. Carry an umbrella and stay dry.
